tagline: Congratulations! Pick a colour theme below - your planner is two clicks away.
excel_note: Prefer Excel? The .xlsx files are included in your download and open in Excel 2016 or later.
steps: Sign in to your Google account, then click a button above and choose “Make a copy”. The copy is yours alone.
Open the Setup tab. Enter your names, wedding date and total budget. The budget split fills itself in.
List what you are paying for on the Expenses tab: an estimate first, the real price once you have it, and what you have paid.
Add your guests on the Guest List tab, one row each. Record replies, meals and table numbers as they come in.
Work through the Checklist, and keep an eye on the Dashboard.
tips: Yellow cells are yours to type in. Pale yellow cells are filled in for you and can be typed over.
Want to see it working first? Open a sample-data copy and explore.
To share it with your partner, use the Share button in your own copy.
terms: For personal use by one couple. Please do not share, resell or redistribute this file or its links.
support: Questions? Message the shop on Etsy and we will help.
